paper_title: SRPO Enhancing Multimodal LLM Reasoning via Reflection-Aware   Reinforcement Learning
caption: : Self-reflection SFT data statistic

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата представлява стълбовидна визуализация на броя примери (samples) в набор от данни за self-reflection SFT, разпределени по шест категории тип „reasoning“. Хоризонталната ос съдържа категориите и е обозначена с имената им, изписани под стълбовете под наклон; категориите са подредени в последователност отляво надясно като: Mathematical Reasoning, General Reasoning, Natural Scene Reasoning, Physical Reasoning, Logical Puzzle Reasoning и Chemical Reasoning (редът изглежда зададен според величината на стойностите, от по-големи към по-малки). Вертикалната ос е обозначена като “Number of Samples” и използва логаритмична скала с основни деления, маркирани като 10^2, 10^3 и 10^4; стойностите са брой (без посочени единици). Над всеки стълб е изписана точната числена стойност: 7025 за Mathematical Reasoning, 1709 за General Reasoning, 413 за Natural Scene Reasoning, 232 за Physical Reasoning, 91 за Logical Puzzle Reasoning и 49 за Chemical Reasoning. Всички стълбове са в една серия, оцветени в светлосиньо, без легенда и без допълнително визуално подчертаване на отделни категории.
model_annotations.Chinese: 该柱状图用于展示“Self-reflection SFT data statistic”，即不同推理类别下的样本数量分布。横轴为类别轴，按从左到右依次标注为 Mathematical Reasoning、General Reasoning、Natural Scene Reasoning、Physical Reasoning、Logical Puzzle Reasoning、Chemical Reasoning，类别标签以倾斜方式显示；纵轴为数值轴，标签为“Number of Samples”，采用对数刻度（以 10 的幂次标注，如 10^2、10^3、10^4），数值范围从约 10^2 到 10^4，刻度间隔为按数量级（每一档为 10 倍）递增。图中共有 6 根浅蓝色柱状条，柱顶均标注了精确数值：Mathematical Reasoning 为 7025（柱高接近 10^4）、General Reasoning 为 1709（介于 10^3 与 10^4 之间）、Natural Scene Reasoning 为 413（介于 10^2 与 10^3 之间）、Physical Reasoning 为 232（介于 10^2 与 10^3 之间）、Logical Puzzle Reasoning 为 91（略低于 10^2）、Chemical Reasoning 为 49（低于 10^2）。柱状图为单系列、非分组/非堆叠形式，没有图例；柱体样式一致、无额外强调标记或注释（除柱顶数值标签外），类别在横轴上的排列未显示为按字母顺序或明确的规则排序（仅按图中所示顺序呈现）。
model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of self-reflection SFT data counts across several reasoning categories. The category axis is the horizontal axis, showing six labeled categories in left-to-right order: Mathematical Reasoning, General Reasoning, Natural Scene Reasoning, Physical Reasoning, Logical Puzzle Reasoning, and Chemical Reasoning; the category labels are angled for readability. The value axis is the vertical axis labeled “Number of Samples,” displayed on a logarithmic scale with major tick labels at approximately \(10^2\), \(10^3\), and \(10^4\), spanning roughly from the tens up to ten-thousands. Each category is represented by a single light-blue vertical bar with a numeric annotation above it: Mathematical Reasoning is labeled 7025, General Reasoning 1709, Natural Scene Reasoning 413, Physical Reasoning 232, Logical Puzzle Reasoning 91, and Chemical Reasoning 49. The bars appear ordered in descending count from left to right, and there is no legend or additional visual emphasis beyond the value labels above the bars.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm stellt die Statistik der Anzahl von Self‑reflection‑SFT‑Datenbeispielen nach verschiedenen Reasoning‑Kategorien dar. Die Kategorien sind auf der horizontalen Achse angeordnet (von links nach rechts: Mathematical Reasoning, General Reasoning, Natural Scene Reasoning, Physical Reasoning, Logical Puzzle Reasoning, Chemical Reasoning) und die Kategorienbeschriftungen sind schräg gesetzt; eine explizite Achsenbeschriftung für die x‑Achse ist nicht erkennbar. Die vertikale Achse ist mit „Number of Samples“ beschriftet und verwendet eine logarithmische Skala mit Tick‑Marken bei 10², 10³ und 10⁴ (entsprechend einem Wertebereich im Diagramm von grob unter 10² bis 10⁴). Es sind sechs einfarbige, hellblaue Balken dargestellt, jeweils mit einem Zahlenlabel oberhalb des Balkens: Mathematical Reasoning ist mit 7025 beschriftet, General Reasoning mit 1709, Natural Scene Reasoning mit 413, Physical Reasoning mit 232, Logical Puzzle Reasoning mit 91 und Chemical Reasoning mit 49; die Balken sind alle gleich gestaltet (keine erkennbaren Umrandungen, Muster, Legende oder Hervorhebungen) und erscheinen in der Reihenfolge der Kategorien von links nach rechts ohne zusätzliche Sortierkennzeichnung.
